Lady Biker Hit by Car in Gurugram; Driver Claims Self-Defense

A woman riding a motorcycle in Gurugram was struck by a car. The driver, identified as Kalyan Bansla, claimed the incident was not intentional. He stated that the biker was riding erratically around his car. Bansla also claimed the viral video of the incident is incomplete and demanded the full event be shown. He identified himself as an international kabaddi player.
